title: FilesEditParams
description: Apply one strict line-addressed patch to a file. The revision must come from files.read for this exact canonical file and every addressed line must have been displayed by that read. UTF-8 text is required; original line endings are preserved.

revision.description: Opaque byte-exact revision returned by files.read.

patch.description: One-file patch using PUT N.=M:, PUT <N:, PUT >N:, and CUT N.=M. Body rows begin with literal +; line numbers refer to the original read.

result.title: FilesEditResult
result.description: The result is either an applied edit with a new revision or an actionable refusal; a refusal is a tool result, not a run failure.
